title: SI 2022-198 Supreme Court (Fees) (Civil Cases) (Amendment) Regulations, 2022 (No.9)
text:
S.I. 198 of 2022
1341
Statutory Instrument 198 of 2022.
[CAP. 7:13
Supreme Court (Fees) (Civil Cases) (Amendment) Regulations, 
2022 (No. 9)
 
IT is hereby notified that the Minister of Justice, Legal and 
Parliamentary Affairs has, in terms of section 35 of the Supreme 
Court Act [Chapter 7:13], made the following regulations:—
 
1. These regulations may be cited as the Supreme Court (Fees) 
(Civil Cases) (Amendment) Regulations, 2022 (No.9).
	
2.	 The Supreme Court (Fees) (Civil Cases) Regulations, 1992, 
published in Statutory Instrument 425 of 1992, are amended by the 
repeal of the Schedule and the substitution of—

NB. The fees may be payable in Zimbabwean dollars at the prevailing interbank rate.
	
3. 	The Supreme Court (Fees) (Civil Cases) (Amendment) 
Regulations, 2020 (No. 8), published in Statutory Instrument 214 of 
2020, are hereby repealed.
 
       
Supplement to the Zimbabwean Government Gazette Extraordinary dated the
